en.headline: AFCD orders neutering after Stanley cafe dog complaint
en.dek: Officers took a 10-year-old dog for inspection after a report of a suspected fighting breed at a Stanley eatery; the owner arranged emergency surgery to avoid impoundment.
body: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department is investigating a suspected fighting-dog case after officers responded to a public complaint at a Stanley eating place on Wednesday.

The department said staff inspected a dog at the scene and took the animal to an animal management centre. Officials told the owner that the dog would be impounded unless a registered veterinary surgeon carried out neutering and issued a valid certificate. The owner said the 10-year-old dog was a Staffordshire bull terrier with no history of attacks and described the demand as unreasonable, but arranged an emergency appointment to avoid seizure.

AFCD said it would consider prosecution if there was sufficient evidence of illegal possession of a fighting dog. Under the Dangerous Dogs Regulation, specified fighting breeds and their crosses must be neutered by a registered veterinary surgeon, and owners must hold a valid certificate. Offenders face a maximum fine of HK$50,000 and six months’ imprisonment.

The Environment and Ecology Bureau and AFCD have already said they are reviewing the legal definition of fighting dogs after a recent string of attacks. Chief Executive John Lee said this week that the government would examine whether existing laws and penalties were sufficient and that owners must keep dogs under proper control in public places.

zh.headline: 漁護署赤柱食肄接投訴 要求狗主為十歲犬絕育
zh.dek: 署方周三接報巡查懷疑格鬥犬後將犬隻帶走調查，表明若不由註冊獸醫絕育便會扣押，狗主其後安排緊急手術。
body: 漁農自然護理署正調查一宗懷疑非法管有格鬥犬個案。署方周三接獲市民投訴，指有人攜帶懷疑格鬥犬隻進入赤柱一間食肄，其後派員到場巡查。
漁護署表示，人員將有關犬隻帶返動物管理中心調查，並向狗主表明，除非由註冊獸醫進行絕育並取得有效證明書，否則會扣押該犬。狗主向傳媒表示，該十歲犬隻為史丹福鬥牛㹴，飼養多年沒有襲擊紀錄，認為有關要求不合理，但為免愛犬被扣留，已緊急安排絕育手術。
漁護署回覆查詢時說，如有足夠證據，會依法提出檢控。根據《危險狗隻規例》，指定格鬥犬品種及其混種必須由註冊獸醫絕育，狗主亦須持有有效證明書，違例最高可被罰款五萬元及監禁六個月。
環境及生態局與漁護署早前已表示，會檢視格鬥犬的法律定義及相關規管。行政長官李家超本周亦說，政府會研究現行法例及罰則是否足夠，並強調主人在公眾地方必須妥善控制犬隻。
